name: Nick "zyn3rgy" Powers
biography: An offensive security professional with experience in leading and offering red team assessments and penetration testing across several attack surfaces to a diverse set of industries. Professional interests include furthering knowledge of Windows internals, static and dynamic Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) evasion, as well as initial access attack surface research. Passionate about contributing back to the security community by speaking at conferences such as Defcon, Wild West Hackin’ Fest, and Troopers along with instructing course content at conferences such as BlackHat USA.
